description: Rotating OAuth2 refresh tokens with family-based reuse detection: replaying an already-rotated token revokes every token sharing its familyId. System-managed — never reachable through the generic entity API.

tokenHash.description: SHA-256 of the raw opaque refresh token

familyId.description: Shared across a rotation chain — this is what lets reuse revoke the whole chain, not just one token

scope.description: Never exceeds the scope of the original grant, even across rotations

parentId.description: Previous token id in the rotation chain, for audit

revokedAt.description: Set on rotation-consumption or explicit revoke; a non-null value being presented again is the reuse-detection trigger

user.description: User this refresh token was issued to
